notes.title: Free to play
notes.content:
The game is going to be free to play! ːsteamhappyː

I made this game many years ago without pretendiding to anything, just as a project for self-education. This became a part of my portfolio and I even earn a few bucks and bought a new PC ːwinter2019happyyulː

Nobody plays it for many days ːsteamboredː but many still have this game on their wishlists. I think it would be fair to make this game free now for anyone who would like to try it.

ːmetalmː Peace!
